title: Kombucha Brew Batch Progress
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kombucha:reading
| stats earliest(_time) as start, latest(ph) as ph, avg(temp_c) as temp by batch
| eval days_fermenting=round((now()-start)/86400,1)
| eval stage=case(ph>3.5,"early",ph>2.8,"ready soon",1=1,"ready")
| sort - days_fermenting
description: Follows each kombucha batch by pH and temperature so you know when a brew has fermented to the tartness you like.
value: Kombucha readiness is a pH question, not a calendar one; tracking it per batch means every brew tastes the way you want.
implementation: Ingest pH and temperature per batch; schedule daily and watch each batch progress toward ready.
visualization: Table of batches with days fermenting, pH, and a stage label.
grandmaExplanation: It follows each batch of kombucha as it brews and tells you when it is ready to drink.
